title: Papermaking processes described in the Engi Shiki: a theoretical note on ancient document papers
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: Yuyama describes Engishiki rules specifying 20,000 annual sheets and proposes that ancient Japanese papers used plant-derived neri and a tamezuki-like nagashizuki process. These are rules and scholarly reconstruction, not directly measured historical output.
